# Netflix Mail

> Fast, private inbox viewer for shared Netflix login codes and household verification prompts.

Netflix Mail is a lightweight web app that lets trusted household members quickly view sign-in codes, OTPs, and household verification emails sent to a shared Netflix account inbox — without exposing the underlying mailbox credentials.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Profile selection and secure code viewer entry point.
- [Netflix Household Verification Guide](/guides/netflix-household-verification): Detailed walkthrough of Netflix's "Whose TV is this?" prompts, 7-day travel codes, and household management.
